segments.ja424:1.3: Taṃ tassa hoti atthāya, no ca yaṃ tattha ḍayhati.
segments.ja424:2.3: Nīharetheva dānena, dinnaṃ hoti sunīhataṃ [sunībhataṃ (sī. syā. pī.), sunibbhataṃ (ka.)].
segments.ja424:3.1: Yo dhammaladdhassa dadāti dānaṃ, uṭṭhānavīriyādhigatassa jantu;
segments.ja424:3.3: Atikkamma so vetaraṇiṃ [vettaraṇiṃ (ka.)] yamassa, dibbāni ṭhānāni upeti macco.
segments.ja424:4.1: Dānañca yuddhañca samānamāhu, appāpi santā bahuke jinanti;
segments.ja424:4.3: Appampi ce saddahāno dadāti, teneva so hoti sukhī parattha.
segments.ja424:5.1: Viceyya dānaṃ sugatappasatthaṃ, ye dakkhiṇeyyā idha jīvaloke;
segments.ja424:5.3: Etesu dinnāni mahapphalāni, bījāni vuttāni yathā sukhette.
segments.ja424:6.1: Yo pāṇabhūtāni aheṭhayaṃ caraṃ, parūpavādā na karoti pāpaṃ;
segments.ja424:6.3: Bhīruṃ pasaṃsanti na tattha sūraṃ, bhayā hi santo na karonti pāpaṃ.
segments.ja424:8.1: Addhā hi dānaṃ bahudhā pasatthaṃ, dānā ca kho dhammapadaṃva seyyo;
segments.ja424:8.3: Pubbeva hi pubbatareva santo [pubbe ca hi pubbatare ca santo (saṃ. ni.1.33)], nibbānamevajjhagamuṃ sapaññāti.
